title: What are fake voices?
body:
What are fake voices?

A fake voice is when a computer copies a person's voice:
• A scammer calls mom and speaks in son's voice: "Mom, urgently need money!"
• Sounds like a real voice, but it's a deception!

⚠️ If someone calls and asks for money - always call that person back yourself!

✅ ALADDIN Premium analyzes voice and detects fakes.
